notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's realized pet contract is four client verbs (CMSG_PET_ACTION, CMSG_PET_STOP_ATTACK, CMSG_PET_CANCEL_AURA, CMSG_PET_SET_ACTION) and four server packets (SMSG_PET_SPELLS including the zero-guid teardown and both cooldown tail shapes, SMSG_PET_MODE, SMSG_PET_ACTION_FEEDBACK, SMSG_PET_CAST_FAILED). MSUI implements all eight.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: Both pre-pass 'missing' entries are false positives: CMSG_PET_CANCEL_AURA has a real sender (WorldSession.cs:301), and CMSG_PET_SPELL_AUTOCAST exists in Benilla only as an opcode constant - Benilla itself drives autocast through CMSG_PET_ACTION/CMSG_PET_SET_ACTION, never sending it.
